request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Change only his face: he is smiling and friendly, not fierce. Erase the slanted brows and the open mouth with teeth; give him two round happy black dot eyes with a white shine, two small pink cheeks and one wide closed smile, a curved line of white icing. Do not redraw anything else: keep the gingerbread head, the icing trim, the bow tie, the shoulders, the raised fist, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
